name: mcp-for-blender
description: Community open-source Blender integration for Codex (not affiliated with the Blender Foundation).

interface.longDescription: A community-built, open-source project. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the Blender Foundation. Connects Codex to a running Blender through the MCP for Blender addon. Create and edit objects, materials and lighting, pull free assets from Poly Haven, Sketchfab and Poly Pizza with a visual picker, @-mention scene objects, and watch the viewport beside the conversation.
defaultPrompt: Add a wooden chair from Poly Pizza
